title: Senate's top Democratic investigator looking into Tether payments to Bo Hines' firm
summary: Senator Richard Blumenthal, the ranking Democrat on the investigations subcommittee, added a probe of the ex-White House crypto adviser to his list of crypto interests.

title: A16z is the latest VC giant to widen bets beyond crypto and into AI and emerging tech
summary: The venture investor behind early bets on Coinbase, Solana and Uniswap said is broadening its focus, joining other crypto investment firms looking beyond blockchain to artificial intelligence and tech themes.

title: Irish central bank fines Coinbase Ireland $3.6 million over fund safeguarding failures
summary: When Silvergate was on the verge of collapse in 2023, Coinbase instructed 30 customers to deposit funds into an alternate account held by Coinbase at another U.S. bank.

title: Switzerland approves first spot Bitcoin ETF for retail investors
summary: BIT Asset Management’s Bitcoin Fund ETF is expected to begin trading on SIX Swiss Exchange in November, with its public offering restricted to Switzerland.

title: Pentagon bans US forces from using military info to bet in prediction markets
summary: Hegseth warned that prediction market wagers could expose military operations to adversaries.

summary: DeepSeek banned from US federal civilian agencies over spying fears. Singapore firm behind Europe’s only spot Bitcoin ETF, as Switzerland partners with Vietnam on crypto tech.

title: Circle shareholder sues Trump, World Liberty and Steve Witkoff over crypto deals
summary: According to a Circle shareholder, the US president’s “corruption” through USD1 left the company unable to compete with stablecoins, harming USDC.

title: Dune launches real-time data feeds covering 200 onchain trading venues
summary: The new service aims to bring onchain trading data into institutional financial systems as tokenized stock markets expand and face growing scrutiny.

summary: While crypto-aligned PACs have stepped up spending in Ohio, a committee launched by the co-founders of crypto exchange Gemini made one of its first forays into the Lone Star State.

title: Underdog taps zerohash to bring crypto deposits to prediction markets
summary: The new funding option, expected to launch later this year, will allow eligible Underdog users to deposit digital assets around the clock.

summary: According to BlocksBridge, Bitcoin’s mining difficulty is rising despite the industry’s AI transition, with smaller operators potentially absorbing equipment abandoned by larger competitors.

title: Irish cenbank fines Coinbase arm $3.6M for oversight, safeguard failures
summary: According to the Central Bank of Ireland, Coinbase Ireland had agreed with the facts around the enforcement action and will be subject to fines and sanctions upon approval by a high court.

summary: Bitcoin extended daily losses to 3% as US stocks came under pressure from President Donald Trump’s comments on Iran military action.

title: Is the Internet Safe Again After the PHP Nightmare? What You Need to Know

title: ChatGPT Teaches Messi Chess—On a Board It Set Up Wrong, With an Opening That Loses in Four Moves
summary: Lionel Messi’s ChatGPT ad has the AI teaching him chess on a board with kings and queens swapped, then suggesting an opening that loses in four moves on that board.

title: a16z Drops Crypto From Its Name, Widens Bets to AI and Frontier Tech
summary: Andreessen Horowitz is renaming its crypto fund a16z Frontier and widening its scope to AI, autonomous machines and biology, saying the line between crypto and everyday tech has blurred.

title: Meta Creates Non-Voting Stock to Fund AI Buildout, Keeping Zuckerberg in Control
summary: Meta will hand shareholders a free non-voting share for every share they own in January, giving it a way to raise equity for AI spending without diluting Zuckerberg's 60.6% vote.

title: Coinbase Fined Again in Ireland, This Time $3.6M Over Fund Safeguarding
summary: The Central Bank of Ireland penalized Coinbase Ireland €3,252,618 for leaning too heavily on its U.S. parent and leaving its safeguarding account underfunded—its second hit to the exchange’s European arm in the last year.

title: Tesla's Profit Drops 43% as Musk Starts Building Robots and Plans to Sell Driverless Cabs
summary: Tesla earned $787 million last quarter, down from $1.37 billion, as spending on robots and self-driving cars soared. Optimus is in production, and Tesla aims to get Cybercabs to customers by year-end.

title: Oil Climbs Above $111 as AI Stocks Slide, Dragging the S&P 500 and Global Markets With Them
summary: Brent crude hit a five-month high while Nvidia, Meta and chip stocks fell, pulling Asia's benchmark indexes down by up to 3.5% a week after South Korea's Kospi plunged 7.57%.

title: Bitcoin ETFs Erase October Losses With $1 Billion in Three Days
summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs have drawn about $1.07 billion over three sessions, pushing October flows to a gain of roughly $460 million, even as Bitcoin and Ethereum prices slipped.

title: What Is a Neocloud? The GPU Clouds Powering the AI Boom

title: Major Banks Find Rogue AI Agents Inside Customer Accounts—And They’re 'Horrified'
summary: Major banks including Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, Bank of America, and Citi are moving to restrict third-party AI agents that log in with customers’ credentials.
